question: Given a Seurat object with broad cell type annotations, perform sub-clustering analysis on the T-cell population to investigate T-cell subtypes (e.g., CD4+, CD8+, regulatory T-cells). Find the top marker genes per sub-cluster and save a UMAP plot with cells colored by sub-cluster.

expected_output.guidelines: Plot must show T-cells on a UMAP colored by sub-cluster identity; exact cluster count, colors, fonts, and pixel layout may differ.

Top marker genes per T-cell sub-cluster must match the reference in gene identity; avg_log2FC and p_val_adj values must match within 1% relative absolute error; column order, row order, and sub-cluster label integers may differ.
